During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Balosar system/Legends|Balosar system]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Members of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] Squadron, supported by the Republic navy, attempted to destroy an [[Balosar Outpost|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], which was defended by several ships of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The Empire had, according to [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] analysis, illegally constructed the hidden space station in the republic-aligned Balosar system to act as a staging point for covert assaults on Republic territories. The Republic learned of this and sent all available forces, consisting of three [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] and a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escort, to destroy the space station. Resistance was however fiercer than expected and the [[Coruscant Aegis]] Squadron was called in as reinforcements.<ref name="Balosar Outpost" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears as the Space Combat mission "Balosar Outpost" in the MMORPG [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]] and is available to Republic players. It is part of the mission [[Operation Searing Light]] together with "[[Battle of Javaal|Javaal Fleet Action]]".<ref name="Balosar Outpost" />
